title: Python Official Documentation
content: Python is a programming language. The official documentation covers the Python tutorial, language reference, standard library, and installation.

title: Python Tutorial
content: The Python tutorial introduces syntax, data structures, control flow, functions, modules, exceptions, and classes.

title: HTTPX Documentation
content: HTTPX is an HTTP client for Python. It supports synchronous and asynchronous requests, connection pooling, timeouts, and HTTP status handling.

title: Pydantic Documentation
content: Pydantic validates data using Python type annotations. Models support field constraints, structured validation errors, and JSON schema generation.

title: Pytest Documentation
content: Pytest is a testing framework for Python. It supports fixtures, parametrization, assertions, test discovery, and plugins.
